statement: For the Lewis--Won permutation crossword grids under the definitions frozen in source.md and problem.md, max_{w in S_9} |RP(Grid(w))| = 28549. As a strengthening, equality holds exactly for the two one-line permutations 321456987 and 789654123.
contribution: An exact, reproducible exhaustive computation over all 362880 permutations resolves the previously open-supported n=9 instance. It constructs each 16-by-16 word-incidence matrix, computes its permanent with an integer subset recurrence, reproduces all published maxima through n=8, and independently recounts both equality cases by direct perfect-matching backtracking.
